test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence is in active voice. Change the voice of the sentence. Select the correct option from the sentences given in options.

The story explores the conflicting range of human emotions.

options.text: The conflicting range of human emotions had explored by the story.
The conflicting range of human emotions did explored by the story.
The conflicting range of human emotions is explored by the story.
The conflicting range of human emotions has explored by the story.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The conflicting range of human emotions is explored by the story**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.
